title: Pin and record Laya's model weights revision on every run
description: laya.load() takes no revision argument and downloads Hugging Face refs/main (convaiinnovations/laya), so the package version does not pin the weights. The sexuality run (2026-09-23) resolved weights commit 5e7b2b1b8ca2ecdd3f2322d94069c9b6ce7e844b under both laya 0.3.7 and 0.3.9. Record the resolved weights commit in every Laya answer record and study build note; pin it for future runs (load from a snapshot_download at a fixed revision); and establish which weights the earlier Laya runs (batch 1, religion v2, batch 2, veteran) used, from HF cache metadata or run dates against the repo's commit history, flagging any run whose weights differ.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Log 2026-09-23: filed after the sexuality run showed laya.load() resolves weights from refs/main. Next: list Hugging Face commits for convaiinnovations/laya with dates and compare with our run dates.

comments.author: home
comments.text: 2026-09-23 finding: every weight file on convaiinnovations/laya is byte-identical (same LFS sha256) from commit 458d7563c5 (2026-09-19 06:48 UTC, 'bundle the typed-decisions checkpoint') through 5e7b2b1b8c (2026-09-23): model.safetensors 891102d37268…, typed-decisions/model.safetensors 4fa56de72383…, multilingual/model.safetensors 9d628fd971b7…. Later commits changed only docs and images. All upstream-Laya runs in this programme (batch 1 onward, 2026-09-21 to 09-23) therefore used the same weights. Remaining: pin the revision in the engine adapter and record it in answer records.

right_now_summary: Laya used identical weights across all runs; the adapter still needs a fixed revision and run records.
